comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. Coordinates are real OSM lat/lon projected into world space. trigger_radius = in compressed-world meters. needs_owner_review=true means the owner's lived knowledge should verify the placement — he knows the road better than any map. All communities are along the V1 route: Norman Manley Airport → Palisadoes → Harbour View → Kingston → Spanish Town Road → Bog Walk → Linstead → Moneague → Faith's Pen → Fern Gully → Ocho Rios.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow strip of land carrying Norman Manley Highway — sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Harbour View roundabout — where the Palisadoes meets Windward Road and the potholes begin

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial east Kingston — cement plant visible on the left

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hillside community above Windward Road; exact trigger point on the curated route needs owner verification

communities.name: East Kingston
communities.note: Entering the city proper on Windward Road

communities.name: Jones Town
communities.note: West of downtown; included if the curated Kingston route passes through here

communities.name: Trenchtown
communities.note: Birthplace of reggae and Bob Marley — strong diaspora recognition; include if route brushes past

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major Kingston junction — Maxfield Ave meets South Camp Rd

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's modern business district — hotels, banks, corporate towers

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Kingston's uptown hub — the 1813 clock tower, buses, markets and the loudest horns on the island

communities.name: Three Miles
communities.note: Named for its distance from the city centre; on Spanish Town Road heading west

communities.name: Six Miles
communities.note: Six miles from downtown Kingston on the Spanish Town Road — owner to confirm exact roadside feel

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Former capital of Jamaica — over 500 years of history, the square and courthouse are iconic

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the gorge — Rio Cobre runs below, road narrows dramatically

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: "Linstead Market" — home of the famous folk song; busy country market town

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Small town between Linstead and Moneague on the A1

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: High ground junction town — where the wrong-turn mountain moment tempts the player

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshops at the summit — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival; the smell gets you before the sign does

communities.name: Claremont
communities.note: Small town near the northern end of Fern Gully — owner to confirm it is on the curated route

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Three kilometres of road canopied by bamboo and ferns — one of the most beautiful drives in the Caribbean

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Journey's end — cruise ships, Dunn's River Falls, and a well-earned bath
